snippet.title: BALL x PIT | AVAILABLE NOW on Mobile
snippet.description:
OUT NOW and free to try!
Visit http://www.ballxpit.com for more

BALL x PIT launches on mobile platforms, with every single feature that made the game such a smash hit on PC and consoles intact.

Fuse Your Balls
Combine over 60 randomized balls to create chaotic, overpowered synergies.

Build New Ballbylon
Construct over 70 unique structures to power up, unlock heroes, and expand your empire.

Explore New Realms
Battle through deserts, caverns, and forests teeming with bizarre foes and massive bosses.

Recruit Fellow Hunters
Team up with treasure-seeking heroes that change the way you play.

Over a million players have already fallen into the pit — now it’s your turn, wherever you are.

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/

Subscribe for more: https://devolver.link/youtube
